'''Acorns''' were wild nuts found on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Some incarnations were leafy [[Color/Legends|green]] in appearance.

==Description==
Acorns were native to the [[Moon/Legends|worlds]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]<ref name="lessons" /> and [[Plagen]].<ref name="TH">{{WEGCite|story=Treasure Hunt (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref> Some incarnations of the acorn on Endor were leafy [[Color/Legends|green]] in appearance.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
They were often foraged by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who used acorns as an ingredient to make other foods.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Acorns appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' as a [[:w:c:swg:Forage (Ability)|foraged]] [[:w:c:swg:Foraged Rare Component|component]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] for use in [[:w:c:swg:Food|food]] [[:w:c:swg:Item|items]]. In the [[Star Wars video games|game]], they appeared green and leafy. However, it should be noted that the same graphical model for acorns was used for other items in the game, such as [[celto]] and [[Bristlemelon/Legends|bristlemelon]]. In the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Star Wars: Ewoks'']] episode ''[[The Three Lessons]]'', the acorns appeared more similar to their real-world counterpart.
